t: What he told a man who wanted one answer
a: تَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ لاَ تُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا، وَتُقِيمُ الصَّلاَةَ، وَتُؤْتِي الزَّكَاةَ، وَتَصِلُ الرَّحِمَ
p: Taʿbudu-Llāha lā tushriku bihi shayʾā, wa tuqīmu-ṣ-ṣalāh, wa tuʾti-z-zakāh, wa taṣilu-r-raḥim
m: You worship Allah and associate nothing with Him, you establish the prayer, you give the zakat, and you keep the ties of kinship.
